title: Charge-first census for local-SUSY-descended generators in one compact chiral-clock route
registration_scope: This contract is frozen before the Phase 14A source packet, executable, charge ledger, or result report is created. The literature-motivated expectation that compact proper gauge generators and a rolling-clock residual parameter are trivial is already known, so this cycle is an exact source-scoped reproduction/bridge test and is not eligible for a novelty or universal-no-go claim.

scope_lock.background: A nondegenerate spatially flat homogeneous bosonic FLRW background with compact Cauchy slice Sigma=T^3, one physical neutral chiral scalar Z=(T+iY)/sqrt(2), canonical physical Kahler potential K_phys=Z Zbar (dimensionless calK=K_phys/M_P^2), W identically zero, no vector multiplets, and a monotonic clock patch p_T!=0.
scope_lock.candidate_class: A bounded structural template consisting of: (i) residual standard complex-linear local 4D N=1 supersymmetry parameters preserving the Kallosh bosonic spatially-flat FLRW linear-fermion goldstino gauge; (ii) the Regge-Teitelboim spatial-boundary improvement channel for a differentiable local-SUSY generator; and (iii) the proper bulk-constraint representative in the classical reduced quotient. It excludes nonlinear or inhomogeneous compensating sectors, a full matter-coupled canonical reducibility census, and any independent emergent or nonlocal reduced fermionic symmetry.
scope_lock.candidate_completeness: CONTRACT_TEMPLATE_COMPLETE_CONDITIONAL_ON_STANDARD_DIRAC_DECOMPOSITION only for the three explicitly frozen representatives in candidate_class_id if their source equations, topology, and classical proper-constraint quotient are reproduced exactly. No SOURCE_COMPLETE claim is made for the full matter-coupled canonical theory or for reduced/topological/dressed charges outside this template.

source_versions.scope: Matter-coupled 4D N=1 supergravity on a bosonic spatially-flat FLRW background; goldstino transformation and alpha identities in equations (7.15)-(7.16).

Pure asymptotically-flat 4D N=1 canonical supergravity. Equations (II.33)-(II.35) are the exact sign/variation anchor for the supersymmetry generator and improvement; equation (III.7) is used only for the general constraint-plus-boundary structure. No normalization equivalence with (III.8)/(III.13) is asserted, and the asymptotic formula is not imported into FLRW.
Matter-free classical FLRW transformation/ansatz context only; not a chiral-clock action, canonical reduction, physical inner product, or charge derivation.

scope_lock.single_parent_guard: The executable may combine universally applicable algebraic consequences only after labeling their distinct provenance. It may not claim that the three papers derive one common chiral-clock minisuperspace model.
scope_lock.claim_ceiling: No inference may exceed the frozen bosonic-FLRW linear-fermion goldstino-gauge and Regge-Teitelboim spatial-boundary template. Passing or failing this cycle does not decide the full matter-coupled canonical charge census, nonlinear or inhomogeneous compensating sectors, an independent reduced/dressed charge, a relational branch exchange, a full quantum physical domain, a noncompact boundary route, or all N=1 supergravities.

target_claims.hypothesis: Within the frozen compact route and bounded structural template, at least one differentiable, conserved, gauge-representative-independent, nonzero fermion-odd complex-linear physical charge survives either the goldstino-gauge residual channel or the Regge-Teitelboim spatial-boundary channel after quotienting the proper bulk constraint.
target_claims.necessary_not_sufficient: A positive witness would only keep this selected route alive for a separately preregistered relational branch test. It would not support branch exchange by itself.

target_claims.hypothesis: Opposite relational expanding and contracting branches are superpartners.
target_claims.frozen_status: INCONCLUSIVE_OUT_OF_SCOPE because Phase 14A introduces no relational branch projector and computes no branch cross block.

charge_taxonomy.nonexclusive_warning: Residual, boundary and reduced are not mutually exclusive charge types. Origin and realization are recorded on separate axes, and equivalent physical actions count once.

definitions.proper_local_generator: The smooth periodic local-SUSY generator on the compact slice. Its bulk representative is proportional to the first-class fermionic constraint and is zero in the classical reduced quotient.
definitions.residual: A local-SUSY parameter solving the exact gauge-preserving equation, modulo proper local gauge, whose induced physical action is nonzero.
definitions.boundary: The improvement required to make the canonical generator differentiable at an actual spatial boundary or asymptotic end. The frozen compact route has neither.
definitions.independent_reduced: A fermionic Dirac observable or physical-space symmetry not obtained as a representative of the original local gauge generator. It is explicitly outside the Phase 14A candidate class.

charge_taxonomy.deduplication: Candidates with the same action modulo constraints and proper gauge share one equivalence_class_id and count once.

frozen_assumptions: The physical scalar normalization is Z=(T+iY)/sqrt(2), K_phys=Z Zbar and calK=K_phys/M_P^2. In the Kallosh dimensionless convention m=e^(calK/2)W. W is identically zero, so m, its covariant derivatives, the F-term potential, and m_3/2 vanish; W merely vanishing at one field value is not sufficient.
The clock patch has p_T!=0, a>0, positive lapse magnitude, and finite nonzero fiducial volume, hence |dot Z|^2>0 even if p_Y=0.
The Kallosh goldstino equation is used on its stated bosonic spatially-flat FLRW and linear-fermion domain; alpha>0 is not generalized to arbitrary backgrounds.

The Henneaux surface formula is evidence for the constraint-plus-boundary structure under asymptotically-flat conditions. Only the topological inference that a spatial surface improvement has no integration locus on boundaryless T^3 is used in the frozen route.

A local gauge constraint and its closure are not a nonzero physical charge. Equality to zero is taken in the classical reduced quotient; a quantum statement would additionally require anomaly-free constraints and a common domain.

The goldstino gauge v=0 is used only to census residual local supersymmetry. Full-rank delta v/delta epsilon means that this gauge has no nonzero residual local-SUSY parameter; it does not mean that the 4D action lacks local supersymmetry.
No CPT map, complex conjugation, branch reflection, whole-multiplet flavor transport, worldline supercharge, defect, edge mode, collar, temporal boundary charge, or pseudo-supersymmetry is appended.
All executable comparisons use exact symbolic arithmetic; no floating tolerance, fit, or parameter scan is permitted.
